title: Stardew Valley Farm Planner & Layout Editor | Field & Farm
description: Design eight practice farm landscapes with editable layout ideas, fixed building footprints, sprinkler and scarecrow coverage, interiors and export.
guideText: Choose an original practice landscape or four editable layout ideas for crop blocks, ranching, a river workshop or woodland retreat. Inspect sprinkler and scarecrow coverage and reference construction costs, then export an editable plan. No official terrain.

title: Stardew Valley Community Center Bundle Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track standard Community Center bundles by room, season, quantity and quality. Record remixed requirements manually or review supported local save data.
guideText: Track standard donations and quantities separately. Optional bundles need only the stated number of qualifying slots. Use season and room filters, or record the actual requirements of your remixed bundle in the separate manual checklist.

title: Stardew Valley Museum Collection Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track 95 museum artifacts and minerals, filter acquisition routes, check donation rewards and arrange a practice museum display.
guideText: Discovery is not donation. Use acquisition filters and reward milestones, then arrange items on an original practice display grid. This is not the exact in-game museum floor plan.

title: Stardew Valley Seed & Geode Predictor | Field & Farm
description: Explore PC 1.6.15 reference geode openings, selected Traveling Cart offers, train times, green rain and overnight event candidates.
secondaryKeywords: stardew valley does luck affect geodes
guideText: Compare the next 20 geode openings, selected Traveling Cart offers or a 28-day train, green rain and overnight event calendar. Use the private workspace for personal save fields. Reference predictions are not independently verified in game.

title: Stardew Valley Save & Progress Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Inspect save fields locally, including steps taken, skills, monster goals and collection progress. Keep separate farm profiles in a private workspace.
secondaryKeywords: how many steps have i taken stardew
stardew how many steps have you taken
guideTitle: Inspect a save without uploading it
guideText: Inspect a main-player save locally, including recorded steps, skill XP, monster goals and recognized collections. Review values before merging into the selected farm profile. Missing or ambiguous fields remain unknown.

title: Stardew Valley Crop Profit Calculator & Planner | Field & Farm
description: Compare seasonal crop profits, fertilizer, budget, greenhouse and Ginger Island yields. Plan up to 112 growing days or simulate processing cash flow.
guideText: Compare outdoor harvest schedules, seed budget, growth fertilizer and quality. Check processing cash flow or choose the separate 112-day Greenhouse and Ginger Island model with a finite seed stock and sale margin scenario.

title: Stardew Valley Fair Grange Display Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Score and optimize a nine-slot Grange Display. Browse category-based example items and confirm actual sale values, qualities and available quantities.
guideText: Enter actual sale values, quality and Fair categories. Add reference items by category, then confirm available quantities and optimize the nine-slot display. Samples never assume you own an item.

title: Stardew Valley Fish Collection Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track 72 fish collection entries and filter recorded seasons, locations, times and weather. Review missing fish and export your checklist.
guideText: Filter recorded main-route season, location, weather, time and acquisition method. Missing conditions remain unspecified, not guaranteed. Record actual catches; challenge-only legendary variants are excluded.

title: Stardew Valley Perfection Checklist & Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track weighted perfection requirements, 12 monster eradication goals and collection progress. Compare known minimums, unknown values and waivers.
guideText: Enter observed category counts, compare the weighted completion range and review the 12 monster eradication goals. Load supported local save observations and collections in the private workspace; manual values can override estimates.

title: Stardew Valley Crafting Recipes Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 149 reference crafting recipes, recipe status and ingredient quantities. Build a local material plan.
guideTitle: Prepare a batch of crafting recipes
guideText: Select recipes and batch quantities, then inspect direct ingredients, stock shortages and estimated costs. Batch outputs may contain multiple items. Intermediate recipes and profession-specific ingredient substitutions are not automatically expanded.

title: Stardew Valley Shipping Collection Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Search 154 reference shipping items and record completed shipments. Export your list or load recognized collection progress locally.
guideText: Filter the 154 reference entries and mark an item only after shipping it in the game. Finding or owning an item is not the same as shipping it. Export your checklist for later use.

title: Stardew Valley Cooking Recipes Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Explore 81 cooking recipes, ingredients and completion status. Build a material plan and track progress locally.
guideText: Select recipes, enter batch quantities, and compare required ingredients against current inventory. Unlock hints identify common learning routes. Unknown prices remain unknown; intermediate dishes are not recursively expanded.

title: Stardew Valley Golden Walnut Tracker & Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 130 Golden Walnuts across Ginger Island tasks. Filter by method, record collected walnuts, upgrade spending and missing rewards.
guideTitle: Track lifetime finds separately from spending
guideText: Record repeated drops individually and fixed rewards as complete tasks. The upgrade ledger subtracts purchases from recorded balance, not lifetime collection. Puzzle hints can be revealed when needed.

title: Stardew Valley Farm Types Comparison | Field & Farm
description: Compare eight farm types by reference tillable area and terrain features. Open an original illustrative layout in the farm planner.
guideTitle: Choose a farm for your priorities
guideText: Compare eight farm types by reference area and characteristics. Water, obstacles and sprinkler restrictions affect practical capacity. The original design templates are illustrative, not pixel-accurate game maps.

title: Stardew Valley Grandpa Evaluation Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Calculate Grandpa evaluation points from earnings, skills, friendships and milestones. Check the four-candle threshold and remaining points.
guideText: Enter lifetime earnings, skill levels, friendships and completed milestones. Four candles require at least 12 points in the reference model. Record community center completion and its ceremony separately.

title: Stardew Valley Skills, Professions & Mastery Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Compare five skill XP thresholds, profession branches and mastery progress. Enter values manually or load recognized local save data.
guideText: Enter skill experience and mastery points to compare against thresholds. The overnight level-up event determines actual profession rewards. Mastery points are separate from the five base skill experience values.
